title: StudioProject
description: Studio project identity and bindings. The canonical spec stays the contract with the engine; this file records which spec it was authored against and which modules are in use.

baseSha256.description: SHA-256 of the spec before any derivation.

currentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the spec as last written.

gitCommit.description: Git commit of the engine bundled in the Studio build that last wrote this project.

levels.description: When true, the active level is compiled into runtime.initialEntities and runtime.spawners.

gameplay.description: When true, gameplay modules are compiled into runtime.lives, winScore and collisions.

activeLevel.description: Level compiled into the spec; empty when levels derivation is off.

inputsSha256.description: SHA-256 over the canonical derivation inputs of the last compile; empty when never compiled.

modules.description: Sidecar manifests present, sorted, no duplicates.

slug.description: Project slug (same pattern as project.id in the canonical spec).

sha256OrEmpty.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256, or the empty string when not recorded.
